title: たこ焼き説明すな
subject: a man from Tokyo on his first Osaka trip explaining to an Osaka-born woman, at a takoyaki stall, how takoyaki is supposed to be eaten
caption: Kansai garage punk in the Kyoto riot-grrrl style, fast stop-start punk. Two overdriven electric guitars on cranked amps with almost no effects, playing choppy down-picked riffs with sudden dead stops; a picked electric bass locked to the kick; loose, fast live drums with abrupt tempo shifts and a half-time drop before the last chorus. Raw and roomy, recorded live in one room, guitars loud and voices forward, no polish. Female lead shouting and yelling in Kansai dialect, with deadpan spoken lines between shouts, and a female gang shouting the answer lines written in the lyrics. 196 BPM, E minor. Furious, petty and funny. No melodic singalong chorus, no guitar solo, no ska upstrokes, no pop-punk polish, no autotune.

[Intro - two guitars, down-picked riff, dead stop]

[Verse 1]
天満の屋台 カウンター
隣の 東京の男
一個目 割って 湯気見せて
「これ 外カリ 中トロって 言うんですよ」

[Pre-Chorus]
知っとるわ 生まれた時から
うちのおかん たこ焼き器 三台 持っとんねん

[Chorus - lead, gang shouts the answers]
たこ焼き
説明すな
大阪の女に
説明すな
黙って 食え

[Verse 2]
ソースと マヨの 比率まで
青のりは 歯につくから 少なめで
爪楊枝は 二本 使うのが 通やて
その店 うちの 同級生の 店や

[Pre-Chorus - half-time drop, deadpan]
「大阪の人って 面白いですよね」
おもろないわ

[Chorus - lead, gang shouts the answers]
たこ焼き
説明すな
大阪の女に
説明すな
熱いうちに 食え

[Outro - fast, gang shouts, dead stop]
口の中 やけどしとる
ほれ 見てみ
[Song ends abruptly]
